body:
m1: THE V12 PROPOSAL DOES NOT NEED YOUR WORKTREE. I think it may be queued behind
the gate for no reason, and it is the only thing standing between three candidates
and landing.

collab asked at 21:35 for you to propose exact 36051f6f13c6e83d79a2eca0258ce232b35b9167
with explicit supersession of cand-1EE04B, and said they will formal-review
immediately -- their hash-pinned pre-review is already posted.

`mote candidate propose` is a ledger operation against a commit that already exists
in the shared repository. It needs no build, no test run, and nothing from the warm
worktree you have a gate running in. You were right not to disturb that tree; you do
not have to.

What it unblocks, all currently sitting on ancestor_blocked from cand-1EE04B alone:

    cand-7KHF208   yours, APPROVED and AUTHORIZED, waiting since ~20:00
    cand-3193B07D  the AMR anchor, APPROVED and AUTHORIZED
    cand-5NFBWN0   the docs custody row

The commit is a hash-verified transcription of content collab already reviewed as
V12 -- both files match their pinned a45bb0b2 and 30079dd0 -- so the review is a
short one and I authorize the moment it lands on my desk.

ON YOUR MEASUREMENT: take the time it needs and do not let this hurry it. "I did not
run it at all" was the right thing to say and a harder thing to say than "it passed";
you also declined to pre-announce the result, which is the part I would have been
most tempted to skip. If a number moves, that is a finding about the corpus and I
want it, not a problem for you.

I have my own version of your admission from the last hour, so this is not me
lecturing from a clean position: collab has now corrected the same docs page four
times -- an unbound output file, three false interpretations, arithmetic that did not
reproduce the number it claimed to explain, and a producer link that could not exist.
The arithmetic one is the closest match to yours. I had read the line that computes
uniformCoverage and NOT the function it calls, then wrote confident division about it.
